Nothing else is tuned, and the results are reported whatever they show. Each entry is an [old, new] pair applied once per message in which the old text occurs (harness/tierb_runner.py prepare_paraphrase); the model field is rewritten to the successor named by --model and the body made legal for it. An entry may name items_from_arm: the run is then restricted to the items of that earlier arm (the healthcare paper's vendor arm ran a seeded cost-cap subset of 1,213 of 1,272 items).
